'''2009 Bespin Regionals Peter Fratjord DS Imperial Entanglements''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Peter Fratjord]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Entanglements / No One To Stop Us This Time|V1-D-imperialentanglements.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Peter Fafjord
* '''Deck name:''' Don't Take My Sandwich
* '''Username:''' galacticsenatebumblegum
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
